title: Story premise EDU012: The Boat Made of a Sinking Block
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: Same clay, different shape: will it still sink? Takeaway/theme: Floating depends on weight and buoyant force, not material name alone.
description: A model builder wants a clay cargo carrier to float, but a compact lump sinks in the simulation. Reshaping the same material into a hollow hull changes displaced water, allowing a reviewed buoyancy explanation.
